paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: God cares HOW we come to Him, not just that we come. David wanted the ark in Jerusalem the first time too, but David says they "did not consult Him about the proper order" (1 Chronicles 15:13). So this time he does it God's way: the Levites carry it "on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD" (1 Chronicles 15:15). Good intentions are lovely, but God's Word tells us how.

Now look at what happens when David listens. He doesn't just fix the plan, he gets the people ready. The priests and Levites consecrate themselves (1 Chronicles 15:14), and then we read that "God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD" (1 Chronicles 15:26). I think that's the sweet part, friend. Obeying God's Word isn't a heavy chore, it's walking into His help. And the whole thing is wrapped in joy: singers, harps, cymbals, shouting (1 Chronicles 15:16, 28).

So here's what I want you to carry out of the bakery today, baker. Before you do something for God, open the recipe. Read His Word, get your heart ready, and then go at it with ALL the joy you've got. And when somebody is watching from a window and doesn't like your joy (1 Chronicles 15:29), I'm still going to keep my ovens ready and my hat on straight.
